scene.en: Your friend Ewa has just moved into a flat of her own, and you are visiting for the first time. She is a friend, so you say ty. Let her show you round, ask where the rooms are, and say what you think.

turns.says: Cześć! To jest moje nowe mieszkanie.

meaning.en: Hi! This is my new flat.

replies.text: Ładne i bardzo jasne! Gdzie jest salon?

meaning.en: Nice and very bright! Where is the living room?

acceptedAnswers: Ładne i bardzo jasne! Gdzie jest salon?
Ładne i bardzo jasne. Gdzie jest salon?

note.en: *Ciasne, ale własne* is what you say of your own small flat. Said of Ewa's, it calls her flat cramped. Say something kind: *ładne i bardzo jasne!*

turns.says: Salon jest tutaj, na wprost. Jest z widokiem na park.

meaning.en: The living room is here, straight ahead. It has a view of the park.

replies.text: Bardzo ładny! A gdzie jest kuchnia?

meaning.en: Very nice! And where is the kitchen?

acceptedAnswers: Bardzo ładny! A gdzie jest kuchnia?
Bardzo ładny. A gdzie jest kuchnia?

replies.text: Bardzo ładny! A gdzie jest park?

meaning.en: Very nice! And where is the park?

note.en: The park is outside, in the view from the window. Ask about the rooms you have not seen yet: *a gdzie jest kuchnia?*

turns.says: Kuchnia jest mała, po lewej stronie. A łazienka po prawej.

meaning.en: The kitchen is small, on the left. And the bathroom is on the right.

note.en: Ewa has just told you: the kitchen is on the left. Ask about what you have not seen yet: *a gdzie jest twój pokój?*

turns.says: Tutaj. Łóżko stoi w rogu, a na ścianie wiszą zdjęcia.

meaning.en: Here. The bed is in the corner, and there are photos on the wall.

replies.text: Pokój jest w sam raz. Podoba mi się!

meaning.en: The room is just right. I like it!

acceptedAnswers: Pokój jest w sam raz. Podoba mi się!
Pokój jest w sam raz, podoba mi się!

meaning.en: The photos are lying on the wall.

note.en: Photos on a wall hang: *zdjęcia wiszą na ścianie*. *Leżą* is for things lying flat, such as books on a desk.

turns.says: Dziękuję! Ciasne, ale własne. Chcesz kawę?

meaning.en: Thank you! Small, but my own. Would you like a coffee?

note.en: *Mam dość!* says you are fed up, which is not kind to Ewa. Say yes with *tak, chętnie!*, or no with *nie, dziękuję*.

meaning.en: Good! The coffee is in the kitchen.
